meta.name: Step Up High Water
meta.description:
Twins Tal and Janelle relocate from Ohio to Atlanta, where at their new school High Water is always a beat.

Rated TV-14 · Canceled · First aired 31 Jan 2018 · United States · Language: English · 50 min
Studio: Hollycake Productions, Offspring Entertainment, Free Association · Network: STARZ, YouTube Premium

Not complete. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10 | S3 not on server

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: After their mother is arrested, twins Janelle and Tal are sent to live with their Uncle Al in Atlanta. Janelle learns about a performing arts school, High Water, in their new neighborhood, which may just change everything.

videos.title: Solo
videos.overview: Janelle struggles at her High Water audition after she’s forced outside her comfort zone, while Tal confronts his bullies.

videos.title: The Running Man
videos.overview: Tal fights to keep up with his new classmates, Sage makes an unexpected announcement, and Davis is faced with a family issue that could derail his future.

videos.title: Shuffle
videos.overview: Janelle and Dondre can’t seem to hide their true feelings, while alliances at High Water are challenged.
Sage’s troubles start trending, and Dondre discovers Janelle’s been keeping a secret from him.

videos.title: Duets
videos.overview: Odalie finds out why Davis has been skipping class, King’s loyalties are torn, and Tal finally makes a move on his crush.

videos.title: Dance Craze
videos.overview: Tensions flare at Dondre and Janelle’s over-the-top party, while Johnny forces Tal to face the truth about who he is.

videos.title: Ensemble
videos.overview: Poppy and Janelle open up to one another, as Rigo and Dondre grapple with the events of the party.

videos.title: Choreography
videos.overview: Rigo goes viral and King makes a big reveal to Poppy.

videos.title: Two-Step
videos.overview: Sage Odom’s tour auditions are underway, Uncle Al tries to save the twins, and Collette and East-O’s turbulent past comes to a head.

videos.title: Precision
videos.overview: With Sage’s tour opening in barely two months, Tal, Dondre, Poppy, and Odalie realize just how hard they’ll have to push themselves if they want to truly become a professional dance squad. East-O’s sudden death leaves Rigo with questions and a challenge to his father’s throne in the form of his prodigal Uncle Matty, while Sage surprises Collette by bringing in a frenemy from her past to run point on the tour.

videos.title: Splits
videos.overview: The budding rivalry between Tal and Zo comes to a head at Dondre’s Lit Luau. Odalie brings Davis to the suburbs to meet her parents. Rigo gets an offer from Uncle Matty that puts his relationship with Marquise in jeopardy.

videos.title: Form
videos.overview: Nine and King develop plans to take Rigo’s music to the next level while Rigo’s ties to the streets continue to put a strain on his music and his relationship with Poppy. Meanwhile, Odalie and Davis hit hard times and tension between Tal and Zo grows as Sage heats things up in preparation for the tour.

videos.title: Vogue
videos.overview: When the tour dancers are unable to let loose during an erotic dance routine, Sage demands that they go on a journey to find their sexy. Things start to get hot and heavy with Dondre and Poppy. Sage and Rigo go head-to-head.

videos.title: Inversion
videos.overview: As Nine pushes Sage to tone down his ambitions, Collette takes him on a trip down memory lane to rediscover his artistic roots. Odalie struggles to find balance in both her love life and her dance. Zo takes Tal out for the night of his life... with unforeseen consequences.

videos.title: Isolations
videos.overview: Tal learns a devastating family secret. Sage and the tour dancers build a risky new concept from the ground up. Nine helps Rigo deal with his feelings about Poppy through music, just as Poppy and Dondre confront their feelings for each other.

videos.title: Attitude
videos.overview: Odalie, with the help of Davis, attempts to work through a debilitating injury and preserve her spot on tour as Tal tries to assuage himself of his guilt and earn Odalie's forgiveness. As Rigo's star rises, he struggles to keep the peace amongst his friends and decipher who to trust. Meanwhile, Dondre finally meets the real Sage Odom.

videos.title: Azonto
videos.overview: With Rigo's song about her going viral, Poppy is left with no choice but to respond. Collette takes full control of the tour while Sage is away. Davis helps Uncle Al outside of work.

videos.title: Improvisation
videos.overview: With the tour just four days away, the dancers make final preparations for their big opening night. Poppy’s mom visits High Water for the first time. Tal learns some shocking news from Zo. Rigo gets some help with his dance routine from an unlikely source. Odalie takes a last desperate step. Sage and Collette make a series of stunning final moves to assure the tour’s success.

videos.title: Hip-Hopera
videos.overview: The tour begins! Sage and the dancers take the stage on opening night in Atlanta. Dondre learns a secret that changes everything between him and Poppy. Rigo learns the truth about the death of his father. Odalie has her moment to shine. Uncle Al has a huge surprise for Davis and Justin. Sage has a dramatic proposal for Collette. A shocking return from his past astonishes Tal.
